title: Rumour that the giant ended up at Wright-Patterson
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Rumour that the giant ended up at Wright-Patterson, about after 2005 at Wright-Patterson AFB, Ohio, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: that the giant ended up at Wright Patterson."

plain: A man named Tim Alberino, on Jesse Michels's podcast, talks about a story that US forces captured a twelve-foot giant in Afghanistan. He passes on a rumour that, sometime after 2005, the giant ended up at Wright-Patterson, an Air Force base in Ohio. If true, it would mean the military is holding a being unknown to science.
